// An exposure adjustment in photographic stops: Stops multiplies linear light
// by two to that power; Offset lifts blacks; GammaCorrection bends midtones.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exposure_(photography))
type ExposureAdjustment
    implements IValue
{
    Stops: Number;
    Offset: Number;
    GammaCorrection: Number;
}
